execution.entry_reason: The Region target lives in triton_block_wise_prefill_attention and the witness supplies num_block (block_idx.shape[2]) directly. The official caller flex_prefill_attention derives block_idx internally via get_active_blocks, whose vertical/slash transform emits only lower-triangular block indices, so it can never make num_block exceed total_q_blocks*(total_q_blocks+1)//2; the target assert is therefore boundary tested at the target function's own input interface with an explicit block_idx.
